subject: Champion hand-off, MAP milestones & EB date options
messages:
From: Lindsay Park <lindsay.park@acme.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & EB planning — next steps and sponsor confirmation

Hi David / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The procurement and I talked through next steps and we want to lock down a mutual action plan (MAP) and an Executive Briefing (EB) slot to get our exec sponsor and champion aligned. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm Redwood exec sponsor for the EB (we need an SVP-level advocate to join).
- Share a MAP with milestone owners (legal, security review, pilot criteria) so our PMs can map dates.
- Proposed EB windows: June 14–18 or June 28–30 (AM PT preferred).

Attached is a one-page wish list from our PMs and the evaluation criteria they’ll use during the pilot. Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the exec sponsor and who will own the pilot MAP items? Also loop in procurement for timing/PO constraints (I cc'd Procurement alias).

Thanks,
Lindsay
Lindsay Park
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
ACME Corp
Attachments: ACME-wishlist.docx (stub), Pilot-Eval-Criteria.pdf (stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lindsay Park <lindsay.park@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & EB planning — next steps and sponsor confirmation

Lindsay —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses below and an initial MAP attached (MAP-v1.xlsx) with owners and dates filled in where we have commitments. High level:

1) Executive sponsor: I can commit to having our VP of GTM, Marissa Cole, join the EB as Redwood's exec sponsor. She will own the customer-facing exec alignment and gating decisions.

2) MAP owners & pilot criteria: I populated the spreadsheet with internal owners:
   - Product integration lead: Ben Carter
   - Security/compliance liaison: Karthik Iyer (will coordinate SOC2 evidence & data handling Qs)
   - Legal & contract point: me (David) — I’ll shepherd the SOW/DocuSign timeline.

3) EB dates: We can tentatively hold June 16 (AM PT) as our preferred slot for the first EB. If that doesn't work for your execs, the fallback is June 29 (AM PT). Please confirm availability and whether the EB should be recorded or private.

I’ve also attached an evaluation checklist (Evaluation-Checklist.pdf) to align on pilot gating metrics (latency, cost per inference, reliability targets). If procurement needs a formal timeline for PO/terms, Karthik is your primary.

Next steps:
- Lindsay: confirm which EB date (June 16 vs June 29) and whether Marissa meets your exec sponsor expectations.
- ACME procurement: confirm any blackout dates for signature or PO issuance.
- Ben / Karthik / Marissa: confirm availability for the EB and any pre-read slides you want from Redwood.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP after we lock the EB date and procurement windows.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx, Evaluation-Checklist.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lindsay Park <lindsay.park@acme.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & EB planning — next steps and sponsor confirmation

On Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 11:03 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve also attached an evaluation checklist (Evaluation-Checklist.pdf) to align on pilot gating metrics...

Quick note from product: June 16 AM PT works for our team except we need a hard cut on sample size & test window in the MAP (we suggest a 2-week pilot window starting day of EB + a required set of 5 production scenarios). I added this to the MAP spreadsheet under the pilot milestone.

Karthik — can you confirm SOC2 evidence delivery timeline (we often need 5 business days to pull the report and redact customer-specific bits)? If Procurement has timing constraints we should put those dates into the MAP now so legal can pace the SOW.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lindsay Park <lindsay.park@acme.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement ACME <procure@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & EB planning — next steps and sponsor confirmation

Thanks all — June 16 AM PT is good for the EB. Marissa as exec sponsor looks great.

Procurement notes: PO will be issued the week of June 21 provided we have a final SOW and the MAP owner dates. Procurement (cc) — can you confirm the PO lead time? Our legal also asked for a redline window of 48 hours once SOW is shared.

I attached a signed stub of the MAP so internal stakeholders know this is the agreed timeline (Signed-MAP-stub.pdf). Please send DocuSign for the SOW and EV schedule; we can sign as soon as we have the final SOW.

Lindsay
Lindsay Park
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
ACME Corp
Attachments: Signed-MAP-stub.pdf
